# The Divine Hima

> A 12-room boutique hotel in Sidhpur, Dharamshala (Himachal Pradesh, India), directly opposite the Norbulingka Institute. Mountain-view rooms named after Himalayan passes, an in-house restaurant, café, wood-fired pizzeria and bar. Rated 4.5/5 by 1,264 guests on Google. Built by Sanjay Kumbkarni, a Himalayan geologist.

## Rooms

- [Rooms in Dharamshala](https://thedivinehima.com/divine-rooms/): All 12 rooms in three categories (Deluxe, Superior, Premium), from ₹7,450 to ₹15,000 a night with breakfast included. Each room has its own page at /rooms/<name>/.

## Packages and retreats

- [Holiday packages](https://thedivinehima.com/divine-holiday-packages/): 2-night and 3-night stays with breakfast and dinner, from ₹19,999 for two including taxes.
- [The Himalayan Reset](https://thedivinehima.com/retreats/): A 6-day, 5-night small-group yoga and wellness retreat, from $599 per person all-inclusive, with private rooms.

## Dining

- [Dining](https://thedivinehima.com/dining/): The restaurant (Himachali, Tibetan, Indian, Italian, Japanese, Chinese), Divine Café, Firewood Pizzeria and The Bar By Far. Vegetarian and vegan options.

## About, gallery and contact

- [About](https://thedivinehima.com/about/): The story of the hotel and its founder.
- [Gallery](https://thedivinehima.com/gallery/): Photos of the rooms, dining and views.
- [Contact](https://thedivinehima.com/contact-us/): Phone, WhatsApp, email, directions by air, rail and road.
- [Travel guides](https://thedivinehima.com/blog/): Dharamshala travel guides. Each guide lives at the site root, e.g. https://thedivinehima.com/best-time-to-visit-dharamshala/.

## Key facts

- Address: Opposite Norbulingka Institute, Sidhpur, Dharamshala, Kangra, Himachal Pradesh 176057, India
- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 86269 83777
- Email: reservation@thedivinehima.com
- Check-in 2:00 PM, check-out 11:00 AM
- Complimentary breakfast and daily housekeeping with every stay; room prices exclude taxes
- Cancellation: full refund 14+ days before arrival, 50% refund 3+ days before, no refund after that
- Pet friendly, free on-site parking, free Wi-Fi
- Distances: Gyuto Monastery 2 km, HPCA cricket stadium 6 km, Kangra (Gaggal) airport 12 km, McLeod Ganj about 20 km
- Google rating: 4.5/5 from 1,264 reviews
